title: VisibleManifest
description: The ONLY input to image generation. Assembled by the Director exclusively from entity cards whose current state is revealed to the requested audience. The renderer concatenates prompt_fragments + composition; module text is structurally absent from this path. Audit: the VLM seatbelt checks improv renders against the audit_negatives list.

oneOf.description: Character ids — a private vision on one Box.

state.description: Must equal the card's current revealed state for this audience; the assembler enforces this invariant.

anchor_asset.description: Reference image for conditioning; required for recurring stars.

moment.description: Director-original action description built only from revealed facts.

audit_negatives.description: Descriptions of currently-hidden entities adjacent to this scene; the VLM seatbelt asserts their absence in improv renders.
examples: a partially buried egg among rocks

priority.description: improv = P1, runs only in narration windows; prep = P2, never live.
